product.name: NOMADD Robotic Solar Panel Cleaning System
product.description: A fully automated, waterless robotic system designed to clean solar panel arrays in desert environments without damaging panels.

product.name: NOMADD 1P Edge Runner
product.description: A tracker-compatible robotic cleaning unit with an 8-wheel-drive chassis designed for flexible movement and dust removal on solar arrays.

product.name: NOMADD 2P Edge Runner
product.description: A versatile robotic cleaning system compatible with both fixed tilt and tracker solar arrays, designed for automated dust removal.

product.name: NOMADD Rooftop Installation Cleaning System
product.description: A waterless robotic cleaning system designed to operate on rails attached to rooftop solar panel mounting structures, resistant to high winds.

product.description: Provision of a secure desert testing environment, professional data collection, analysis, and fully installed NOMADD cleaning systems for field trials.
